description: Designed PyTorch recommendation models, TensorFlow document classification pipelines (95%+ accuracy), and computer vision inspection microservices. Developed the Krrishmay multi-agent architecture.
Architected high-throughput web applications including Happy Clinic (Next.js healthcare platform) and SpaceChat (real-time engine). Currently engineering O, a multi-agent AI operating system.
Integrated Arduino microcontrollers and sensor arrays with C++ and Node.js for real-time hardware telemetry tracking and automated device triggers.
